answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Each attempt carries 120 stamped dockets, each costing £38 to have checked, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The desk only stamps a name that carries Vellumbound vellum hall keeper leaf warrant, and the stamp itself rests on a warrant vellum hall keepers show after parchment room trials. Every spiral is counted once. The anchor is checked, not assumed. The clerk notes tundra.
